name: Feralas: A History
summary: In Feralas, you find Feralas: A History, a book Troyas may need. It looks as if nobody has opened it in ages. The book belongs to Daryn Lightwind, so you need to ask whether you may borrow it.

sections.title: A Neglected Book
sections.body: The book's covers are badly worn, and its pages have yellowed. After looking it over, you suspect it may be what Troyas is searching for. You pick it up, then think better of borrowing it without asking. It belongs to Daryn Lightwind, so ask her first.

sections.title: Daryn's Answer
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind takes a moment to consider your request. She will let you borrow Feralas: A History, but only after you have done her a favor.

faq.q: What is the book Feralas: A History?
faq.answer: Feralas: A History has worn covers and yellowed pages. It looks as if nobody has opened it in ages, and may be exactly what Troyas is searching for.
Daryn Lightwind owns the book. Ask her before borrowing it.
It comes after In Search of Knowledge, when Troyas Moonbreeze sent you to speak with Daryn Lightwind about his stave.
